hint: Add exponents when multiplying powers with the same base.

text: Evaluate the integer sum: (-899) + (-613) = ? (Class 6 Integer #295)
explanation: [CBSE Class 6 Syllabus • Integers & Number Line] (-899) + (-613) = -(899 + 613) = -1512.
hint: Two negative integers add to a negative sum.

text: Solve for x: 2x + 9 = 27 (Class 6 Equation #296)
explanation: [ICSE Class 6 Syllabus • Linear Equations in One Variable] 2x = 18 => x = 9 = 9.
hint: Subtract the constant, then divide by the coefficient.

text: Expand the binomial square (3x + 1)² using algebraic identity: (Class 6 Algebra #297)
explanation: [IGCSE Class 6 Syllabus • Algebraic Expressions & Identities] (3x + 1)² = 9x² + 2(3)(1)x + 1 = 9x² + 6x + 1.

text: What is 30% of 100? (Class 6 Percentage #298)
explanation: [CBSE Class 6 Syllabus • Ratio, Proportion & Percentages] (30 / 100) × 100 = 30.
hint: Multiply the number by the percentage fraction.

text: In a triangle, two angles measure 45° and 61°. Find the third angle: (Class 6 Triangle #299)
explanation: [ICSE Class 6 Syllabus • Geometry & Triangles] Sum of angles in a triangle is 180°. 180° - (45° + 61°) = 74°.
hint: Angle sum property of triangle is 180°.
